Sven L: Morning all  Sven here, joining ML infra today. First-day checklist Qs: where do I request the dev laptop image, who to ping for VPN access, and is there a preferred SSH key format? Also, quick icebreaker: I once rode a motorbike across Iceland, I lived in a treehouse, I speak fluent Portuguese. Which one's the lie?

Tara P: welcome Sven! :wave: File the laptop request at https://support.redwood.ai/new-laptop and pick 'developer image'. For VPN/Okta, ping #eng-security; @Greg H usually helps with regional invites.

devex-bot: Welcome Sven! Your onboarding checklist: https://onboard.redwood.ai/2141590000. Remaining items: request laptop, accept Okta invite, add SSH key. Reply "laptop done" / "okta done" to update.

Greg H: Hi Sven, pinged you an invite for Okta. We prefer ed25519 keys. Example add: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "sven@redwood.ai"` then paste `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` into GitHub.

People Ops: Hi Sven  if you need a parking badge or office access, email people-ops@redwood.ai with your office location and badge type. New-hire swag is shipped on request.

Ivy C: Hey Sven, welcome to ML infra! Lunch with the team Friday at 12:15 in the cafe (Zoom link posted in #new-hires). Also, if you want a mentor, I can pair you with Raj for the first two weeks.

Sven L: Thanks everyone  OK I'll file the laptop ticket now. Fun fact answer: the lie is that I lived in a treehouse  (I wish!). Looking forward to lunch and pairing with Raj. I'll reply "laptop done" when the ticket is in.
